sourceFile: 19. TIU C11-20  Report test Frame mold #2 -#3 each by cavty 2026.1.24.. RAW_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but overmixes normal, mold, cavity, side, and raw acoustic data into one unclear changed-factor case.
issues: Changed factor is overbroad and not evidence-clean.
Baseline versus test conditions are ambiguous.
Sheet2 LEFT data is not tied to the report title context.
Measurement outcomes include extraction artifacts and header-derived stats.
Function defects and SPL raw tables are not cleanly grouped.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the primary comparison Normal vs frame mold #2/#3 by cavity?
Should Sheet2 LEFT results be included in this case?
Should acoustic SPL data be retained as an outcome?
correctionPlan: Define one primary changed factor from report purpose.
Separate mold-level and cavity-level subgroup keys.
Validate Normal, #2, #3, and cavity rows against table headers.
Remove artifact measurements from RAW DATA and headers.
Keep only outcomes with comparable conditions and clear row support.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping citations are insufficient for final evidence.
